summary: BHP Group Limited filed its Annual Report 2026 on Form 6-K, covering the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026. The report describes the company's operations, forward-looking statements, and asset portfolio, including references to divested mines (Daunia and Blackwater) from FY2024. No special-situation transaction is announced; the filing is a routine annual report disclosure by a foreign private issuer. The document provides standard company details and cautionary language regarding future performance, with no merger, acquisition, tender, or restructuring terms.
